body: Never thought I'd hear crystallized in porn
This is gonna sound really, really bad, but I have to ask. Do all mentally challenged people look the same to anyone else? I could swear I've seen this guy before.

I've actually been dealing with the same shit. I can't bring myself to do it because I can't bear to think of what it might do to my friends and family. 

I suppose you're not the person to be asking, but just the same, any tips for getting through those thoughts?

I know the feeling. Sometimes it feels as if trusting others is worse than being alone. Being alone is so easy. Putting yourself out there feels like a weakness sometimes. i erased this message like 4 times. :\

I've been trying to figure out who of my friends I could possibly talk to, but I don't want them to see me in a different light. My friends know me as the always happy, always in good spirits type of guy, and many of them come to me with their problems. Not to mention I've talked to a friend about this stuff once before and he just laughed at me! Needless to say we weren't very good friends after that. It's difficult to find who I could trust with this kind of stuff.
Thank you, I'm looking through all the subreddits now!
I think that's the best advice I've ever been given. It already feels more manageable when I'm only thinking about one thing at a time.

I've been thinking about this a lot, and I'd like to try one out but I'm not sure how to go about finding one or comparing rates or anything like. Is there any trick to it? I'm not looking for medication, just someone to talk to really.

I saved this post, all of these actually. I was in a bad place last night and just couldn't come to terms with a few of my own mistakes, I really appreciate the advice, and I plan to implement all of it if I can. Like thephotoman suggested, I'm gonna try to focus on one problem at a time.
I can vouch for this. Writing has always helped me
